skills.name: designing-technical-uis
skills.pickWhen: The repository has a technical UI (workbench, calculator, analysis or comparison view, dashboard, data tables, settings, admin tool, CLI output) or user-facing docs
skills.paths: The folders that hold UI or docs code, when they are not the whole repository
skills.pointer: `UI screens and user-facing text: load the designing-technical-uis skill first.` in the `AGENTS.md` of each of those folders (the root `AGENTS.md` for the whole repository). A folder `AGENTS.md` created for it gets a `CLAUDE.md` with `@AGENTS.md` when Claude Code is selected.

packs.title: Ponytail
packs.pickWhen: The smallest complete change per task: a behavior mode for Claude Code and Codex, set to level full. It adds about 1,000 tokens at each session start (its rules and a map of the repository) and about 700 per subagent

packs.title: Matt Pocock's skills
packs.pickWhen: The project uses his grilling, spec, tickets, test-first and review skills

prompts.why: writes `docs/agents/` (issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs) and the `## Agent skills` block

packs.pointer: Matt Pocock's skills (`mattpocock-skills:<name>`) are installed: grilling, spec and tickets, tests first, code review against the issue, pull request text.

skills.name: ask-matt
skills.does: Routes you to the skill or flow that fits your situation.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.does: A diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.does: Interviews you to sharpen a plan or design and writes ADRs and glossary entries as it goes.

skills.name: triage
skills.does: Moves issues and external pull requests through triage roles and writes agent-ready briefs.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.does: Scans for deepening opportunities, reports them as an HTML page, then grills through the one you pick.

skills.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
skills.does: Sets up the issue tracker, triage labels and domain doc layout in `docs/agents/`, once per repository.

skills.name: tdd
skills.does: Test-driven development, red-green-refactor.

skills.name: to-spec
skills.does: Turns the conversation into a spec on the issue tracker.

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.does: Breaks a plan or spec into tracer-bullet tickets with their blocking edges.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.does: Plans work too big for one session as decision tickets and resolves them one by one.

skills.name: implement
skills.does: Implements a piece of work from a spec or tickets.

skills.name: implement-spec
skills.does: Implements the result of `to-spec` and `to-tickets`.

skills.name: prototype
skills.does: Builds a throwaway prototype to answer a design question.

skills.name: research
skills.does: Investigates a question against primary sources and writes the findings to a Markdown file.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.does: Builds the domain model: `GLOSSARY.md` and ADRs.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.does: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules and their seams.

skills.name: code-review
skills.does: Reviews changes since a fixed point against the repository's standards and the issue or spec.

skills.name: pr
skills.does: Writes a pull request body.

skills.name: retro
skills.does: A retrospective on a coding session.

skills.name: wizard
skills.does: Generates an interactive bash wizard for steps only a human can do.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.does: Interviews you to sharpen a plan or design.

skills.name: grilling
skills.does: Grills you about a plan, decision or idea.

skills.name: handoff
skills.does: Compacts the conversation into a handoff document for another agent.

skills.name: teach
skills.does: Teaches you a skill or concept within this workspace.

skills.name: to-questionnaire
skills.does: Turns an open decision into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.

skills.name: wait-what
skills.does: Re-pitches the last message when it did not land.

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.does: Writing skills, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` for agents.
